primary.description: Electric Indigo — primary actions, active states, brand moments

secondary.description: Sky Blue — secondary accents, charts, links

neutral.description: Borders, dividers, icons, placeholders ONLY (not body text)

accent_text.description: Terracotta — accent text, hero title highlights, stat numbers, score values, links (NOT buttons)

spacing_layout.scale: Tailwind Scale (p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16)

grid_system.dashboard: Bento Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
grid_system.landing: Tetris Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8
rules: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).
Never fill 100% of the grid perfectly in marketing pages.
Use col-span-2 or col-span-full for hero elements.

buttons.style: Pill (rounded-full) for CTAs, rounded-lg for inline actions

cards.style: White surface on cream, 1px border (border-border), soft shadow

inputs.style: bg-white dark:bg-card border-border focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary rounded-xl h-11

charts.style: Minimalist, thin lines, no grid lines unless necessary. Use palette colors.

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky headers, modal overlays, 'Lecture Recording' active state.

landing_hero.alt: Students studying in a modern library
landing_hero.usage: Hero section background or main visual

universal_guidelines: Do not use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Outfit'.
Do not use gradients for text.
Do not center align the app container.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
Do NOT use lavender/purple background orbs (#a882de family) — use indigo/sky accents.
Body text must use the text token (#4A4036 light / #FFFFFF dark), never neutral #AD9C8E.
Accent/highlight text (hero titles, stat numbers, scores, links) uses terracotta #C2410C, NOT indigo.
Indigo #4F46E5 is reserved for buttons, active nav states, and focus rings ONLY.
Cards are white (#FFFFFF) on cream (#F7E6CA) in light mode.
instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 'Bento Grid' layout for dashboards. Use the warm palette strictly. Ensure dark mode is fully supported and tested. Use the provided image URLs for the respective sections. Implement the 'Glassmorphism' effect (20px blur) for headers and the lecture recording overlay.
